items.title: [Bug] AMF crashes when N2 forwards a mismatched UE ID into N1 empty-context cleanup
items.body:
## Bug Description

OAI CN5G AMF v2.2.1 logs a UE ID mismatch but still forwards an `UplinkNASTransport` to N1 when the RAN UE NGAP ID is valid and the AMF UE NGAP ID is unknown. On Authentication Failure, the N1 failure path dereferences an empty NAS context (`std::shared_ptr`), terminating AMF. An N2 peer able to reach the AMF NGAP/SCTP interface can trigger a denial of service.

## To Reproduce

1. Start AMF, establish an SCTP association, and complete NG Setup.
2. Send an `InitialUEMessage` containing a valid SUCI Registration Request; retain the RAN UE NGAP ID.
3. Send `UplinkNASTransport` with the same RAN UE ID, forged AMF UE ID `0xffffffff`, and NAS Authentication Failure `7e005914`.

## Expected Behavior

AMF should reject or discard a message whose AMF and RAN UE NGAP IDs do not identify the same UE and remain available. It must not access a missing NAS context.

## Observed Behavior

The AMF container exits with code 139. The kernel log records `segfault at 0x39`; `OOMKilled=false`, the AMF process is absent, and the N2 SCTP probe fails. The application log may end after a normal debug message without printing `FATAL`. Identity Response (`7e005c14`) and Security Mode Complete (`7e005e`) were also dynamically verified to reach the same failure cleanup path.

## Root Cause

In `src/amf-app/amf_n2.cpp:896-902`, AMF finds the UE context by RAN UE ID, logs the AMF UE ID mismatch, but does not return. At `:913-923`, it still forwards the AMF UE ID from the message and the NAS PDU to N1.

In `src/amf-app/amf_n1.cpp:688-695`, the local `std::shared_ptr<nas_context> nc` starts empty; Authentication Failure skips the initial context lookup. Its handler returns `false` when no matching NAS state exists. The caller at `:711-719` sends Authentication Reject and then unconditionally invokes `complete_common_procedure(*nc)`. Dereferencing the empty `nc` terminates AMF; the observed kernel fault address was `0x39`.

The failure chain is: valid RAN ID plus forged AMF ID → N2 forwards the mismatch → N1 has no matching NAS context → handler returns failure → unchecked dereference of `nc`.

## Environment

- OAI CN5G AMF v2.2.1
- Docker container `oai-amf`
- OS: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS
- Kernel version: 6.8.0-71-generic

## Tace Files
